fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects attempts of decoding a base64 Gzip archive via PowerShell. This technique is often used as a method to load malicious content into memory afterward.
fields.name: Suspicious FromBase64String Usage On Gzip Archive - Process Creation
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "FromBase64String" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "MemoryStream" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "H4sI"))
